connector.name: Actionlayer
connector.registryDescription: Concierge for AI agents: takes action in the physical world - book, order, register, resolve.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.actionlayer.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package actionlayer. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.actionlayer, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
